platform.name: Know Your Dept (KYD)
platform.description: The official student and faculty portal for department resources, notes, PYQs, faculty directory, events, and student communities.

questions.q: How can I access lecture notes?
questions.a: Navigate to the Notes section from the resources page. You can filter notes by Year (1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th Year) and subject code.

questions.q: What subjects are currently available in the Notes section?
questions.a: Available subjects include: YCS 1001 (Introduction to Computing), YMA 1001 (Mathematics I), YCS 3001 (Data Structures), YCS 3002 (Algorithms), YCS 5001 (Operating Systems), and YCS 7001 (Machine Learning).

questions.q: Can students upload their own notes?
questions.a: Yes! Logged-in students can upload notes via the Upload button in the Notes resource section. Uploaded notes undergo a quick peer review before being published.

questions.q: Where can I find PYQs for exams?
questions.a: Visit the PYQs section under Resources. You can view and download Midterm and Final exam papers categorized by academic year and subject.
Currently we have Midterm and Final question papers from 2022, 2023, and 2024 for 1st Year to 4th Year courses.

questions.q: How do I contact my department professors?
questions.a: Go to the Teachers section on the homepage or navigation bar. You can view teacher profiles, emails, office room numbers, and research domains.

questions.q: Who are the key faculty members in BTech?
questions.a: Dr. Dharampal Singh (Professor - Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Office: Floor 9, Room 1003, Email: d.singh@jisuniversity.edu) and Dr. Sandip Roy (Associate Professor - Data Structures & Algorithms, Office: Floor 9, Room 1006, Email: s.roy@jisuniversity.edu).

questions.q: Who teaches BCA and BPharm courses?
questions.a: BCA faculty: Dr. Anya Sharma (Software Engineering) and Prof. Laura Jones (DBMS/Networking). BPharm faculty: Dr. Marcus Green and Dr. David Khan.
Upcoming events include TechFest 2026 on May 15 (Main Auditorium), Spring Cultural Gala on April 20 (Open Air Theatre), and Alumni Meet 2026 on June 5.

questions.q: How do I register or participate in department events?
questions.a: Visit the Events page, click on the event card, and follow the registration button or contact the student event coordinator listed.

questions.q: What are student communities in KYD?
questions.a: Communities are interest-based groups (e.g., Coding Club, AI & Robotics Group, Cyber Security Forum) where students collaborate, share resources, and organize workshops.

questions.q: How do I join a community?
questions.a: Click on Communities in the top navigation bar, select a community, and click 'Join Community'.

questions.q: What is the mandatory attendance requirement?
questions.a: A minimum of 75% attendance in theory and practical classes is required to be eligible for end-semester examinations.

questions.q: What are the department lab timings?
questions.a: Computer & Research Labs are open Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

questions.q: Who do I contact for website or account issues?
questions.a: You can reach out to support@jisuniversity.edu or visit the Department Admin Office (Floor 9, Room 1001).
